title: Singapore PM Wong earns ‘cool points’ for using viral Filipino song

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Is Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong a fan of OPM (original Pilipino music)? Filipino netizens are asking after the Singaporean leader used Grizzy Bub’s viral track “Dito ang Tingin” in a social media video of his arrival in Manila for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. Wong’s choice of the catchy Filipino hip-hop track drew amused reactions online, with some netizens finding it cute that the Singaporean leader picked a popular OPM song for his arrival video.
